title: Gloomhaven: Jaws of the Lion
subtitle: A fully cooperative campaign of tactical combat in the Gloomhaven universe
tagline: The perfect entry point into the world of Gloomhaven
loreSummary: You are a member of 'Jaws of the Lion', one of the most infamous mercenary groups in this run-down backwater. When a sinister cabal starts making people disappear, it falls to you to get to the bottom of it.
keyFeatures: Card-driven tactical combat (No dice, pure strategy)
Learn-to-play tutorial guide over the first 5 scenarios
Play directly in the scenario book (no map tiles to assemble)
Four unique classes, each with their own asymmetric playstyle

jotl_standard.name: Standard Campaign
jotl_standard.description: The full 25-scenario branching storyline to the conclusion.

jotl_quick.name: Quick Story Focus
jotl_quick.description: A direct path through the main story, bypassing most optional side scenarios.
